entities.summary: Carl Grossberg, originally Georg Carl Wilhelm Grandmontagne was a German painter associated with the New Objectivity movement. He is best known for his urban and industrial scenes. Carl Grossberg was a architects & engineers from Elberfeld (1894-09-06, Elberfeld–1940-10-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
